objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Forge the user cookie so the server runs your code when it decodes it, then read /ctf/flag.
hints: The application greets you by a name it reads from a cookie. Look at how the cookie is encoded and what the server does with it after decoding.
Python's pickle rebuilds objects by calling functions the data names. The flag is at /ctf/flag.

steps.title: Find the input
steps.prompt: Which cookie carries the value the server decodes? (cookie name)

steps.title: Name the encoding
steps.prompt: How is the cookie value encoded before it is unpickled?

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class is this? (two words)

steps.title: Name the module
steps.prompt: Which Python module deserializes the value? (module name)
